text: Write a phrase such as NOW IS THE TIME FOR ALL GOOD MEN on the plain strip: a letter found twice may be taken from either place, so one plain letter has several code letters and the message keeps its length. That would flatten K4's letter counts.

Every 26-letter window of the sculpture's texts and of Carter's book that holds the 13 letters of the known words, against the standard or KRYPTOS strip, either way, with a repeating key of 1-26: the known letters allow a set of key values at each place; the sets must meet in every slot.

No phrase fits K4 at any key length up to 25; at 26, with a single check, K4 fits as copies do. F2.3 closed for these phrases; any phrase at all would be a free alphabet, which the known letters cannot decide.
